name: Generate canonical TimeSpace export

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      as_of:
        description: Literal confirmed 4h UTC cutoff
        required: true
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  export:
    # No registered corpus artifact exists today. This job is intentionally
    # unreachable on GitHub-hosted runners and remains PENDING until Task 7
    # proves a runner with the exact `zenquant-data` corpus mount is online.
    runs-on: [self-hosted, zenquant-data]
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 1
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v6
      - name: Verify registered corpus precondition
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          uv sync --frozen
          test -f data/derived/trend_research/20260824/BTCUSDT/5m/data.parquet
          test -f data/derived/trend_research/20260824/BTCUSDT/funding/data.parquet
          test -f data/derived/trend_research/20260824/BTCUSDT/1d/data.parquet
          uv run python - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          from zenquant.research.time_space_replay import _registered_source_files
          from zenquant.research.registration import load_execution_manifest
          manifest = load_execution_manifest(
              Path("config/research/registrations/time_space_shadow_execution_v1.json")
          )
          _registered_source_files(manifest.payload["sources"])
          PY
      - name: Generate from registered baseline and point-in-time slices
        shell: bash
        env:
          REQUESTED_AS_OF: ${{ inputs.as_of }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          uv run python scripts/export_time_space_architecture.py \
            --execution-manifest config/research/registrations/time_space_shadow_execution_v1.json \
            --hypothesis-manifest config/research/time_space_shadow_hypothesis_v1.json \
            --output-dir time-space-export \
            --provider-run-id "$GITHUB_RUN_ID" \
            --as-of "$REQUESTED_AS_OF"
          cutoff=$(python -c 'from scripts.export_time_space_architecture import _parse_as_of; import sys; print(_parse_as_of(sys.argv[1]))' "$REQUESTED_AS_OF")
          printf 'EXPORT_CUTOFF=%s\n' "$cutoff" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: time-space-export-${{ env.EXPORT_CUTOFF }}-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: time-space-export
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 90
